concepts.form: Executive diagnostic pop-up and appointment-led proof lab
concepts.tension: Operations leaders cannot quickly translate power interruptions into a decision-ready resilience brief.
concepts.behaviour: Move from passive interest to a booked, client-authorised load and continuity assessment.
concepts.mechanic: A 12-minute 'critical-load card' produces a named assessment booking and consented follow-up.
concepts.budget_scale: Consultation-led: spend prioritises facilitation, data-capture workflow and compact proof modules over crowd scale.
concepts.season: Proposed for September 2026 as a pre-Q4 continuity-planning clinic; date and venue TBC.

concepts.territory: See the System, See the Decision
concepts.tension: Commercial buyers see technical options but lack a comparable route from current energy use to a scoped solution.
concepts.behaviour: Move from brochure collection to a client-approved site-survey request.
concepts.mechanic: A 'bill-to-blueprint' station turns a volunteered consumption range into a survey request, subject to consent and engineering validation.
concepts.budget_scale: Route-led: spend changes primarily with stop count, transport, temporary engineering, crew travel and local permissions.
concepts.season: Proposed October 2026 business-continuity route, scheduled away from the 25–27 October Thadingyut public holidays; route/venue/permits TBC.

concepts.form: Micro-business product launch and after-dark retail activation
concepts.tension: Small operators fear a solution will be complicated, expensive or disruptive to install.
concepts.behaviour: Move from uncertainty to a verified product-demo appointment and affordability conversation.
concepts.mechanic: A four-task night-shift demo unlocks a QR appointment slot; no saving, output or availability claim is made at the activation.
concepts.budget_scale: Demo-module-led: spend prioritises safe task-zone fabrication, controlled lighting and customer appointment operations.
concepts.season: Proposed for early November 2026, before the 23–24 November Tazaungdaing public holidays; client-approved retail venue and operating hours TBC.

concepts.form: Invitation-only executive site walk and press-preview format
concepts.tension: Decision-makers want proof of installation quality and after-sales thinking, not only product claims.
concepts.behaviour: Move from generic interest to a governed tender or engineering-scoping conversation.
concepts.mechanic: A signed visitor checklist and a 'questions for your site' card prompt a follow-up technical briefing.
concepts.budget_scale: Assurance-led: spend scales with controlled access, safety, documentation, technical staging and small-group hospitality rather than audience volume.
concepts.season: Proposed for late November 2026 after the listed Tazaungdaing holidays, subject to client site, safety, stakeholder and permission approvals.

concepts.tension: A growing category requires buyers to understand the quality of handover and service, while practitioners need a consistent customer-explanation standard.
concepts.behaviour: Move from ad-hoc selling to a client-approved learning pathway and consented lead-routing standard.
concepts.mechanic: A practical knowledge check and service-script rehearsal qualify attendees for a next-step accreditation conversation, not a public credential claim.
concepts.budget_scale: Capability-led: spend focuses on curriculum, facilitation, participant operations, assessment design and reusable training capture.
concepts.season: Proposed for the first half of December 2026 as a year-end capability reset; programme partner, venue and accreditation status TBC.

concepts.tension: Fleet and dealer leaders may treat electrification and energy resilience as separate decisions.
concepts.behaviour: Move from generic EV curiosity to a booked fleet-readiness workshop.
concepts.mechanic: A route-board session captures operational variables and books a client-reviewed feasibility conversation.
concepts.budget_scale: Mobility-forum-led: spend varies by vehicle/hardware access, safety marshals, executive hospitality and interactive route-board technology.
concepts.season: Proposed for September–October 2026 business-planning season; venue, vehicle access, charger hardware and permissions TBC.

concepts.form: Community listening programme and proposed/TBC social-impact activation
concepts.tension: Community-energy conversations can become performative if local priorities, safeguards and selection criteria are not visible.
concepts.behaviour: Move from passive awareness to consented participation in an evidence-led community needs conversation.
concepts.mechanic: A facilitated needs wall and opt-in feedback card generate a transparent, non-binding shortlisting brief.
concepts.budget_scale: Safeguarding-led: spend is reserved for facilitation, accessibility, consent, translation, local logistics and transparent report-back—not unverified giving claims.
concepts.season: Proposed for December 2026 community reflection period; partner, location, participation safeguards and any delivery commitment TBC.

concepts.form: Paid digital funnel and interactive decision UI
concepts.tension: Prospects can research equipment but struggle to know what information is needed before a meaningful conversation.
concepts.behaviour: Move from unqualified clicks to a consented, information-ready assessment booking.
concepts.mechanic: A five-step calculator captures the user's priority, not an installation promise, then routes to a reviewed booking flow.
concepts.budget_scale: Performance-led: spend flexes between media, UX, analytics instrumentation, localisation and CRM rather than physical fabrication.
concepts.season: Proposed for December 2026 budget-planning and re-engagement windows; media inventory, data policy and destination experience TBC.

concepts.form: Proof-led content series and monitored social challenge
concepts.tension: Performance claims can blur together when buyers cannot see how a solution is evaluated in normal working conditions.
concepts.behaviour: Move from passive video viewing to a consented request for a verification-oriented consultation.
concepts.mechanic: Each episode ends with a question checklist and a voluntary booking prompt, never a public endurance or performance guarantee.
concepts.budget_scale: Editorial-led: spend scales with episode count, subject-matter review, studio controls, post-production versioning and moderation capacity.
concepts.season: Proposed for late November through December 2026 as a Q4 proof-and-planning content series; challenge mechanic and claims review TBC.

concepts.form: CRM reactivation and account-based decision-sprint programme
concepts.territory: The Next Decision Is Still Yours
concepts.tension: Qualified conversations can stall when a buyer's internal timeline changes, even though the underlying need remains.
concepts.behaviour: Move from dormant lead status to an explicit close, defer or re-scope decision.
concepts.mechanic: A three-message 'renewal window' offers a one-click priority choice and a booked decision sprint only to consented contacts.
concepts.budget_scale: Precision-CRM-led: spend concentrates on segmentation, content personalisation, workflow governance, sales enablement and measurement rather than reach media.
concepts.season: Proposed for December 2026, avoiding 4 December National Day and 25 December Christmas Day communication dates unless the client confirms operational suitability.

registry_note: Beauty/cosmetics completed as the user-requested next two-hour batch after Logistics: 10 integrated campaign proposals with dedicated social/TikTok preparation, 10 separate commercial storyboards, 120 frames, locally validated 130/130, Drive archived and live tracker read-back verified. logistics is an allowed command-center industry code and differs from the immediately prior fnb batch. It was selected before research and concept development to preserve required batch variety.

beauty is an allowed command-center industry code explicitly requested by the user and differs from the immediately prior logistics batch. The batch is reserved before research to preserve lifecycle integrity. Earlier 2026-08-20 adjacent beauty/wellness ideation does not replace this new dedicated cosmetics batch.
selection_log.campaign_channel_requirement: Every campaign must include a social-media preparation workstream and a TikTok-specific preparation workstream where appropriate; these do not replace the separate commercial/storyboard track.
